attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Idaho state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Idaho Code § 63-3024: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 5.695%. Standard deductions: $15,000 Single/MFS, $30,000 MFJ/QSS, $22,500 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; set result.id_military_retirement_exemption = 0.0; perform ID_Retirement_Benefits_Deduction; add " Idaho Tax Calculation (Form 40, 2025) - 5.3% of taxable income above the zero bracket" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef 0.0 cvd /result.id_military_retirement_exemption xdef /ID_Retirement_Benefits_Deduction performtable " Idaho Tax Calculation (Form 40, 2025) - 5.3% of taxable income above the zero bracket" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: MFJ/QSS: Form 39R line 8a cap $72,324 less Social Security; Form 40 line 16 federal deduction; line 20 worksheet: subtract $9,622, multiply by 5.3%
action_details.action_dsl: set result.id_military_retirement_exemption = the maximum of ((the minimum of result.id_military_retirement_exemption and id_retirement_benefits_cap_joint) - result.total_social_security) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.id_military_retirement_exemption - result.total_deduction) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = (the maximum of (result.computed_state_taxable_income - id_zero_bracket_joint) and 0.0) * id_tax_rate; add " ID Form 39R line 8 retirement benefits deduction $" + result.id_military_retirement_exemption + "; taxable income $" + result.computed_state_taxable_income + "; tax $" + result.computed_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.id_military_retirement_exemption id_retirement_benefits_cap_joint fmin result.total_social_security f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.id_military_retirement_exemption xdef result.state_calc_agi result.id_military_retirement_exemption f- result.total_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income id_zero_bracket_joint f- 0.0 fmax id_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef " ID Form 39R line 8 retirement benefits deduction $" result.id_military_retirement_exemption strconcat "; taxable income $" strconcat result.computed_state_taxable_income strconcat "; tax $" strconcat result.computed_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: HOH: single cap on Form 39R line 8a; the head-of-household zero bracket is the joint figure, $9,622; 5.3%
action_details.action_dsl: set result.id_military_retirement_exemption = the maximum of ((the minimum of result.id_military_retirement_exemption and id_retirement_benefits_cap_single) - result.total_social_security) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.id_military_retirement_exemption - result.total_deduction) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = (the maximum of (result.computed_state_taxable_income - id_zero_bracket_joint) and 0.0) * id_tax_rate; add " ID Form 39R line 8 retirement benefits deduction $" + result.id_military_retirement_exemption + "; taxable income $" + result.computed_state_taxable_income + "; tax $" + result.computed_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.id_military_retirement_exemption id_retirement_benefits_cap_single fmin result.total_social_security f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.id_military_retirement_exemption xdef result.state_calc_agi result.id_military_retirement_exemption f- result.total_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income id_zero_bracket_joint f- 0.0 fmax id_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef " ID Form 39R line 8 retirement benefits deduction $" result.id_military_retirement_exemption strconcat "; taxable income $" strconcat result.computed_state_taxable_income strconcat "; tax $" strconcat result.computed_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Single/MFS: Form 39R line 8a cap $48,216 less Social Security; Form 40 line 16 federal deduction; line 20 worksheet: subtract $4,811, multiply by 5.3%
action_details.action_dsl: set result.id_military_retirement_exemption = the maximum of ((the minimum of result.id_military_retirement_exemption and id_retirement_benefits_cap_single) - result.total_social_security) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.id_military_retirement_exemption - result.total_deduction) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = (the maximum of (result.computed_state_taxable_income - id_zero_bracket_single) and 0.0) * id_tax_rate; add " ID Form 39R line 8 retirement benefits deduction $" + result.id_military_retirement_exemption + "; taxable income $" + result.computed_state_taxable_income + "; tax $" + result.computed_state_tax to job.audit_trail

policy_statement.policy_description: Idaho MFJ/QSS (2025 Form 40): taxable income is federal AGI less Form 39R subtractions (the retirement benefits deduction for military retired pay, capped at $72,324 less Social Security) less the federal deduction (line 16); tax is 5.3% of taxable income over the $9,622 zero bracket (line 20 worksheet; HB 40).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Idaho MFJ/QSS (2025 Form 40): taxable income is federal AGI less Form 39R subtractions (the retirement benefits deduction for military retired pay, capped at $72,324 less Social Security) less the federal deduction (line 16); tax is 5.3% of taxable income over the $9,622 zero bracket (line 20 worksheet; HB 40)."

policy_statement.policy_description: Idaho HOH: as MFJ, with the single $48,216 cap on the retirement benefits deduction.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Idaho HOH: as MFJ, with the single $48,216 cap on the retirement benefits deduction."

policy_statement.policy_description: Idaho Single/MFS (2025 Form 40): federal AGI less the retirement benefits deduction (Form 39R Part B line 8, cap $48,216 less Social Security) less the federal deduction; 5.3% of taxable income over the $4,811 zero bracket. The refundable grocery credit and the $10 permanent building fund tax are not part of the income tax figure.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Idaho Single/MFS (2025 Form 40): federal AGI less the retirement benefits deduction (Form 39R Part B line 8, cap $48,216 less Social Security) less the federal deduction; 5.3% of taxable income over the $4,811 zero bracket. The refundable grocery credit and the $10 permanent building fund tax are not part of the income tax figure."

condition_details.condition_comment: The taxpayer has military retired pay (Form 39R Part B line 8e qualifying benefits)
Under 62: qualifies when employed during the year with enough income to have to file a federal return (63-3022A(1)(b)(iii)); wages stand in for that test

action_details.action_comment: Form 39R Part B line 8e: qualifying retirement benefits of a retired service member; capped on line 8a-8f in ID_Tax

policy_statement.policy_description: 62 or older: the military retired pay is a qualifying retirement benefit for the Idaho retirement benefits deduction (Form 39R Part B line 8; Idaho Code 63-3022A; 2025 Form 39R instructions p. 31).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "62 or older: the military retired pay is a qualifying retirement benefit for the Idaho retirement benefits deduction (Form 39R Part B line 8; Idaho Code 63-3022A; 2025 Form 39R instructions p. 31)."

policy_statement.policy_description: Under 62 and employed: the pay qualifies for the retirement benefits deduction (63-3022A(1)(b)(iii)). The disabled-at-any-age test has no input in the data model.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Under 62 and employed: the pay qualifies for the retirement benefits deduction (63-3022A(1)(b)(iii)). The disabled-at-any-age test has no input in the data model."

policy_statement.policy_description: Under 62 and not employed, or no military retired pay: no deduction.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Under 62 and not employed, or no military retired pay: no deduction."
